fields.statement: Verifier at 9916356b3: go vet and go test -trimpath -count=1 -v ./internal/release/... pass (10 tests), also with HTTP(S)_PROXY pointed at a dead port. Resolver tests run only against an httptest server on localhost (Resolver.URLs and Client set to the fixture; no github.com URL fetched): TestDownloadEachPlatform downloads and checks the archive for all four Platforms (linux/darwin x amd64/arm64); TestNewestBothChannels reports v0.1.0 for release and v0.1.1-12-gabc for latest and rejects an unknown channel; TestDownloadRejectsBadSHA rejects a tampered archive on sha256; TestDownloadRejectsMissingPlatform rejects linux/riscv64 and a platform dropped from the manifest; TestRejectsMalformedManifest rejects non-JSON, empty, wrong-channel, short-sha and missing-url manifests. Diff read: resolve.go bounds reads, checks HTTP status, compares lowercase hex sha256 before returning the archive. gofmt clean; commit trailers and staged actor record correct.
